replies.npc: Genius. No queue. Cold water, but no queue.
"Respectfully: no."

convos.open: "What did they serve? Tell me it's not beans again."

replies.npc: "I knew. My soul knew."
"You lie!" It's jollof. Celebrations everywhere.

convos.open: "Can you save my seat? I'm going back for water."

replies.npc: You defend the seat from three people. They return. Hero.
Somebody takes it in four seconds. You tried.

convos.open: "This meat is so small, I need a microscope to find it."

replies.npc: "Specimen: meat. Size: theoretical."
"…It IS an onion. Betrayal."

convos.open: "Siesta and I can't sleep. Talk to me about anything."

replies.npc: Ten rooms, a pool, a kitchen just for indomie… you both fall asleep halfway.
"…Okay." They're asleep in thirty seconds.

convos.open: "Prep is two and a half hours. My brain stopped at minute twelve."

replies.npc: You quiz quietly. The prep prefect doesn't notice. You both learn something.
"If I get caught, I'm saying you suggested it."

convos.open: "Pssst. What's the answer to number five?"

replies.npc: "You're the best." The prep prefect's head snaps up. You both freeze.
"Wicked." But they work it out.

convos.open: "Lights out, but I'm wide awake. Ghost story?"

replies.npc: Half the dorm is listening by the end. Somebody screams. The house master arrives.
"Fine. Goodnight. Watch out for the old lab ghost." Thanks.

convos.open: "Assembly is so long. I counted the bricks on the stage. 412."

replies.npc: "I did. 413. Somebody added one."
"I'm whispering in my soul."

convos.open: "Afternoon activities! Football, volleyball or doing nothing?"

replies.npc: The match is chaos. You score an own goal. Legendary.
"A professional relaxer. Respect."

convos.open: "Break time! Tuck shop run before the queue forms?"

replies.npc: You get there first. Mama Tuck-shop is impressed by your hunger.
The queue is now 40 people. Dignity has a cost.

convos.open: "Social Night tonight! What songs will the DJ play?"

replies.npc: "And we'll dance to all five. Twice."
"The DJ only has one flash drive." Tragic.

convos.open: "Sunday service was long. The pastor preached about patience. Ironic."

replies.npc: "By force."
"You're a better person than me."

convos.open: "Jumat prayers today. Then rice. Allah is generous."

replies.npc: "And the rice is jollof today. Double blessing."
"If there's any left. No promises."

convos.open: "First week of term and I already miss holidays."

replies.npc: "Day one and I'm already counting."
"You said that last term."

convos.open: "Second term is the longest term. Fact."

replies.npc: "And the hottest."
"…True."

convos.open: "Third term means promotion. Or repeating. Pray for me."

replies.npc: "Amen. Loudly amen."
"Study partners? Okay. Yes."

convos.open: "I just found out I passed my test. PASSED!"

replies.npc: "Thank you! I'm buying everyone pure water!"
"You did tell me."

convos.open: "Can I borrow your bucket? Mine has a hole. Again."

replies.npc: "Bunkmate of the year."
"The bucket curse is real."

convos.open: "Let's rate the beans today. I give it two out of ten."

replies.npc: "Too generous. Zero."
"Hunger has corrupted you."

convos.open: "I lost a mark for spelling 'occurrence'. Two Cs, two Rs. I will never forgive myself."

replies.npc: "One mark is the difference between first and second."
"…Second best now." They're almost smiling.

convos.open: "Bulldozer is not my real name, you know. My real name is Babajide/Bolanle."

replies.npc: A long pause. "…Jide. Call me Jide." A big moment.
"It does, sha." They grin.

convos.open: "Tell me honestly: is my Mr. Bassey impression getting worse?"

replies.npc: "Then I've peaked. What now?"
He tries. It's terrifyingly accurate.

convos.open: "I want to learn to ride a bicycle. Nobody in my family taught me."

replies.npc: You teach her on the games master's bike. She falls twice. Then flies.
"Never too late." She writes it on her rough sheet.

convos.open: "Rate my business idea: renting out umbrellas during rain."

replies.npc: "I know. I just need umbrellas."
"…The problem of trust. Business is hard."

convos.open: "Is it wrong that I like rules? They make me feel safe."

replies.npc: "Thank you. Everyone makes me feel weird about it."
"…Maybe they are."

convos.open: "Teach me how to bargain with Mama Tuck-shop. I always pay full price."

replies.npc: She tries it. She saves ₦20. She's ecstatic.
"Rich people bargain too. That's how they stay rich."

convos.open: "I scored 92 in Chemistry. I didn't even have the textbook."

replies.npc: "I borrowed yours. Every night. You didn't notice."
"Seriously?" He holds it like it's gold.

convos.open: "Can you time my 100m? I need to beat 12 seconds."

replies.npc: 11.8 seconds. He screams so loud the house master comes out.
"Count then. One-Mississippi…"

convos.open: "Will you pray for me? Just a short one."

replies.npc: Your prayer is three sentences. She says amen like you just preached for an hour.
"Deal. I already do. Every night."

convos.open: "If you could design anything, what would you design?"

replies.npc: "I'll draw it for you." They do. There are two hammocks.
"Join the club. The club is me."

convos.open: "The noisemakers list is empty today. Do you know how rare that is?"

replies.npc: "I'm celebrating quietly. Very quietly."
"…I was humming earlier. It's fair." They write their name.

convos.open: "My father says if I finish school, I'll be the first engineer in our village."

replies.npc: "Insha Allah." He looks at you like you just made it more real.

replies.say: 🙂 "I'll visit when you light it up"
replies.npc: "You will be the guest of honour."

convos.open: "I tried to explain jollof wars to my London friends. They didn't understand."

replies.npc: "Obviously. Ghana is shaking."
"They'd never survive the beans."

convos.open: "Good morning! Why are you not in class?"

replies.npc: "Run, not walk!"
"Again? Hmm."

convos.open: "Prep is for reading, not gisting. Open your book."

replies.npc: They watch you read for a minute, then nod.
"Then ask quietly." Fair.

convos.open: "I'm on duty this weekend. Please don't give me work."

replies.npc: "You say that every weekend."
"Thank you. You too. Quietly."

convos.open: "Make sure you eat. Hungry students learn nothing."

replies.npc: "Good. Go before the beans finishes."
They sigh and give you a biscuit from their bag. Unexpected.

convos.open: "Na you come late for food again? Take. I keep am for you."

replies.npc: "Don't tell anybody." She winks.
"I know." She laughs.

convos.open: "Rain don come, nobody dey buy. You go buy something or you just dey shelter?"

replies.npc: "Thank you, my customer!"
"Shelter fee na ₦20." She's joking. Probably.

convos.open: "NEPA don take light. Don't light candle inside hostel o!"

replies.npc: "Good. Use torch. Torch no dey burn mattress."
"Good pikin. Share with your neighbour."

convos.open: "Visiting day! Who is coming for you?"

replies.npc: "Good. I will let them in first. For you."
"Then sit with me and listen to the radio small." He shares his kola.

convos.open: "Our juniors don't fear us. Is that good or bad?"

replies.npc: "You'd make a good head prefect."
"Just a sprinkle of fear."

convos.open: "I sent my first junior on an errand. I felt guilty and gave him ₦50."

replies.npc: "Best senior ever. Different perspective."
"Don't tell anyone. I have a reputation."

convos.open: "Remember when we thought SS students were adults? We're not adults."

replies.npc: "Tall, tired children."
"Almost is doing a lot of work there."

convos.open: "Physics is ruining my life. Electricity especially."

replies.npc: "Okay, that I know. It's the rest." You go through it together.
"We study it like history."

convos.open: "Literature is just people being sad in poems."

replies.npc: "Sad people in plays too."
"I have enough feelings already."

convos.open: "Accounting: debits on the left, credits on the right, tears in the middle."

replies.npc: "Assets: none. Liabilities: everything."
You balance one sheet together. It balances. Miracle.

convos.open: "JAMB form is out. Which course? Which school?"

replies.npc: "Ambitious! Unilag will be shaking."
"Think fast. The form closes soon."
"Then we go together. Perfect."

convos.open: "Do you think we'll miss this place?"

replies.npc: "Even the beans." "Especially the beans."
"Okay, not the beans."

convos.open: "I've started saying goodbye to things. Goodbye mango tree. Goodbye tap."

replies.npc: You both wave at the mango tree. A junior watches you, confused.
"Never. I'll say good riddance."

convos.open: "Prefects are being chosen. Did they call you?"

replies.npc: "They will. Your name keeps coming up."
"Too much work? Smart."

convos.open: "We should do a reunion every year after we leave."

replies.npc: "At the same mango tree."
"Of course. I'll make a WhatsApp group." "A group chat." "…A group chat."

convos.open: "Send-forth outfit: I'm thinking all white. Like an angel."

replies.npc: "Angel of SS3."
"Probably with jollof. Worth it."

convos.open: "I tutor two JSS1s every evening. I feel like a teacher."

replies.npc: "Don't. I like it too much already."
"I remember needing someone."

convos.open: "I finally beat Dera in a test. ONE test. I'm framing it."

replies.npc: "They've already challenged me to a rematch."
"Too late, they know. They know everything."

convos.open: "Senior, can you lend me your Integrated Science textbook?"

replies.npc: "I'll take care of it like an egg, Senior!"
"Okay, Senior." They go, a little sad.

convos.open: "Senior, is it true you once stood up to Commander?"

replies.npc: Their eyes go huge. You are now a legend.
"I want to be brave like that."

convos.open: "Senior, my seniors are asking for money. What do I do?"

replies.npc: By evening, the asking has stopped. Mysteriously.
"Sock bank. Okay!"

convos.open: "Senior, which house is the best?"

replies.npc: "I'm in {house} too!" They high-five you.
"So not ours, then." Ouch.

convos.open: "Senior, I broke the dorm window by mistake. Will they expel me?"

replies.npc: They do. A small punishment. Much better than being found out.
"…No." "Then pray." You feel bad about that advice later.

convos.open: "Senior, will you come and watch our football match?"

replies.npc: You cheer. They score. They point at you. You feel a hundred feet tall.
"Please try, Senior!" You do.

convos.open: "Senior, everybody says you're the kindest senior in the hostel."

replies.npc: "Everybody!" It's maybe three people. Still.
"Yes, Senior!" Marketing.

convos.open: "Senior, how do I write a letter home? I don't know what to say."

replies.npc: They write two pages about their friends and one line about food. Perfect.
"That's all?" "That's everything."

convos.open: "You're in {house}, right? Our houses are rivals."

replies.npc: "In your dreams!"
"Friendly until sports day."

convos.open: "Is this the line for water or the line for food?"

replies.npc: "Then I've been standing here for twenty minutes for no reason."
"All lines lead there."

convos.open: "Hey, you dropped this." They hand you your biro.

replies.npc: "No wahala. Biros are precious."
"Rare species. Protect us."

convos.open: "Do you know where the sick bay is? I think I have malaria."

replies.npc: You walk them to Nurse Grace. They say thank you weakly.
"Thank you." They stagger off.

convos.open: "I lost a bet and now I have to sing in the dining hall. Pray for me."

replies.npc: You sing together. Badly. The whole hall cheers.
"The national anthem. Remix version."

convos.open: "Our set is planning a surprise for the cook's birthday. Want in?"

replies.npc: Mama Iyabo cries when you all sing. Extra meat for a week.
"Just your voice. And ₦50."

convos.open: "Why does every senior think they're the president?"

replies.npc: "Absolute power corrupts absolutely. SS3 power corrupts SS3ly."
"Will we, though?"

convos.open: "My parents are fighting a lot. I can hear it on the phone."

replies.npc: "It is. Thanks for listening. Nobody asks."
"…Maybe. Will you come with me?" You go.

convos.open: "I think I'm not smart. Everyone else understands faster."

replies.npc: "…Slow isn't stupid." They repeat it like a password.
Two weeks later, they explain a topic to YOU.

convos.open: "My best friend from primary school forgot me. No letters."

replies.npc: "…I'll try." They write four pages that night.
"Do I?" "You have me." They smile.

convos.open: "My dad lost his job. I don't know if I'll come back next term."

replies.say: 😟 "Talk to the principal about a scholarship"
replies.npc: "Is that a thing?" It is. You walk with them to the admin block.
"We?" "We." It means a lot.

convos.open: "I like someone but they don't know I exist."

replies.npc: "Hello… small. Okay." They practise in the mirror for a week.
"With big English?" "With honest English."

convos.open: "Somebody told me I'm ugly. I've been thinking about it all day."

replies.npc: "…Thanks. I needed to hear that."
You don't say much. You don't need to.

convos.open: "I was homesick today. I cried in the toilet. Is that weak?"

replies.npc: "You did?" "Week one. Every night." They laugh, relieved.
"Yes. Yes please."

convos.open: "My friend and I quarrelled. I don't know how to fix it."

replies.npc: "Even if I'm right?" "Especially then." They try. It works.
"A day. Okay." It takes three, but it works.

convos.open: "Can I tell you something embarrassing? I'm scared of the dark."

replies.npc: "Really?" It sits by their pillow every night after.
"Seriously?" "Seriously." Two brave cowards.

convos.open: "Everybody has a talent. What's mine?"

replies.npc: "Do I?" "Every day." They light up.
"…Nobody's ever said that." They'll remember it.

convos.open: "I got a letter from my grandma. She says she's praying for my exams. In three languages."

replies.npc: "She doesn't play."
"She is. She sends groundnuts too." They share.

convos.open: "My little brother is starting JSS1 next year. Here."

replies.npc: "Would you? Thank you!"
"Survival tips, okay."

convos.open: "Sometimes I feel like nobody would notice if I was gone."

replies.npc: They look at you for a long moment. "…Thank you." Their shoulders drop a little.

replies.say: 🙂 "Want to talk to Nurse Grace or the counsellor?"
replies.npc: "…Maybe. Will you come?" You go together. It helps.

convos.open: "I keep comparing myself to Dera. I'll never be that smart."

replies.npc: "Last-term me was terrible. So I'm winning?" "You're winning."

replies.say: 😂 "Nobody can be Dera. Not even Dera"
replies.npc: "True. They seem exhausted."

convos.open: "My shoes have a hole. My feet are on the ground, literally."

replies.npc: "Are you sure?" They fit. Almost.
It works. Engineering!

convos.open: "I want to be a doctor, but I faint when I see blood."

replies.npc: "No blood? Just talking? PERFECT."
"Patient: unhappy."

convos.open: "Do you think God listens to boarding school prayers?"

replies.npc: "Then He's very busy during exams."
"Good. I've been praying for meat."

convos.open: "I have a crush on {mate}. Don't tell anyone. Seriously."

replies.npc: "Thank you. I'll die if they find out." They won't. From you.
"WHAT." Panic. You're joking. Probably.

convos.open: "I noticed you've been quiet in class. Is everything okay at home?"

replies.npc: "If it ever isn't, my door is open."
They listen for ten minutes. They don't fix it, but you feel lighter.

convos.open: "Do you know why I'm strict? Because I see potential."

replies.npc: "Especially in you. Don't waste it."
They almost laugh. "That too."

convos.open: "Who taught you to write like this? It's actually good."

replies.npc: "Keep a diary. Writers write."

replies.say: 😅 "I copied a style from a novel"
replies.npc: "Good writers steal from the best."

convos.open: "Help me carry these test scripts. Don't look at the scores."

replies.npc: "Good. Integrity." They hand you a sweet.
You see your own score. 74. Not bad. You keep a straight face.

convos.open: "When I was in SS1, I failed Chemistry. Look at me now. A teacher."

replies.npc: "Really. Failure is a teacher too."
"…I teach Chemistry." Life is funny.

convos.open: "I know some of you think I'm wicked."

replies.npc: "Liar. But polite." They smile.
"Exactly. Thank you for understanding the difference."

convos.open: "There is a novel I think you'll love. Promise to return it?"

replies.npc: It's a book about a boy who builds a radio. You finish it in two days.
"A boy, a radio, a village. And courage." You borrow it.

convos.open: "You look pale. Have you eaten?"

replies.npc: "Eat. Then come back if you still feel dizzy." She gives you glucose.
"Fine is not a medical term." She checks your temperature anyway.

convos.open: "You see that toilet in block B? Na me clean am. With my two hands."

replies.npc: "Thank you is enough, my pikin. Nobody ever say am."
"From your mouth to God's ears."

convos.open: "See this yam? Six months of work. Respect your food."

replies.npc: "Good. Now come and weed."
"Six. And the goats tried to eat it twice."

convos.open: "You be my best customer this term. I go give you small bonus."

replies.npc: She drops two biscuits in your bag. Loyalty pays.
"For my business? Never."

convos.open: "You greet me every day. You know how rare that is?"

replies.npc: "Your mother is a good woman."
He nods slowly. Then gives you a kola nut.

convos.open: "My pikin, you dey bring Baba chop again? Na you be my best friend."

replies.npc: "Bingo, you hear? This one na family."
"Business with Baba get good interest."

convos.open: "In my day, this school had no electricity at all. We read with lanterns."

replies.npc: "It was. It made us serious."
He actually laughs. "Touché, young one."

convos.open: "Quick: name three things you'd save if the hostel caught fire."

replies.npc: "Correct order."
"Practical. Boring. Correct."
"WHAT phone?" "…No phone."

convos.open: "Mosquitoes bit me 40 times last night. I counted."

replies.npc: "You're sharing your net? That's love."
"Toxic relationship."

convos.open: "If teachers had to do Saturday labour, who would quit first?"

replies.npc: "Before the first blade of grass."
"From his car. With AC."

convos.open: "Unpopular opinion: rice and beans together is the best school food."

replies.npc: "Finally, someone with taste."
"Then give me your share."

convos.open: "I found ₦20 on the floor. Lucky day or test from God?"

replies.npc: They hand it to the class captain. Integrity. Painful integrity.
"Two pure waters. One for you."

convos.open: "My handwriting changes depending on my mood. Today it's angry."

replies.npc: "Biology diagrams."
It looks like it's shouting. Impressive.

convos.open: "If our class was a soup, what soup would it be?"

replies.npc: "Accurate. Painfully accurate."
"Yes! The drama!"
"Humble soup. Respect."

convos.open: "What's the bravest thing you've done in this school?"

replies.npc: "Legend."
"Truly brave."

convos.open: "Psst. Do you have a calculator? Mine died during the test."

replies.npc: "I owe you my life. And my Maths score."
"We count with fingers like our ancestors."

convos.open: "I learned to whistle! Listen." *wheeeoo*

replies.npc: "Two years of practice."
He's already coming. You both run.

convos.open: "What's one thing you'll never forget about JSS1?"

replies.npc: "Same. Everyone did. Nobody admits it."
"Mine was for laughing during the anthem."

convos.open: "I swear the dining hall chairs are getting smaller."

replies.npc: "…Oh. Puberty."
"I knew it."

convos.open: "Want to make a time capsule? We open it at our reunion."

replies.npc: You bury a tin with notes, a bottle cap and a terrible drawing. Future you will cry.
"Our hopes. And a Jolly Roll wrapper."

convos.open: "Everyone's talking about the social night dance. I can't dance."
